stance: Robots.txt has been subordinated in operational practice by network-level Web Application Firewall configurations and explicit IP matching.
adoption_shape: Perplexity moved to instruct webmasters on granular Cloudflare Skip rules split across distinct IP ranges, showing that crawler governance has shifted from standard file-based directives to active edge firewall exceptions.
new_entrants: Perplexity has refined its footprint by separating traffic into PerplexityBot and Perplexity-User, attempting to control ingress permissions for its distinct IP ranges against strict edge filtering.
watch_for: Whether updated documentation surfaces an alternative path around Cloudflare Bot Fight Mode or confirms that automated edge security remains an unbypassable barrier for AI crawlers.
